Senior Product Manager - Enterprise SaaS
Company: ClarityHR is a fast-growing Indian B2B SaaS company (Bengaluru, Karnataka) offering an AI-powered HR and workforce management platform to mid-market and enterprise customers across India, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East, with 500+ paying customers.

Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka (Hybrid)
Compensation: INR 28-40 LPA + ESOPs (4-year vesting with 1-year cliff)

About the Role:
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the Core Platform product area, covering onboarding, integrations, and admin workflows. You will define the product strategy for our fastest-growing segment, collaborate with a cross-functional team of 15+, and drive outcomes that directly impact NRR and expansion revenue.

Responsibilities:
- Define and communicate a clear multi-quarter product roadmap for the Core Platform, grounded in customer insight and business strategy
- Lead continuous discovery through customer interviews, NPS analysis, support ticket triage, and market research
- Partner with engineering, design, and sales to prioritise, scope, and ship features on a regular cadence
- Own go-to-market planning for major feature launches in collaboration with marketing and customer success
- Define and track success metrics; present product reviews to the leadership team monthly
- Build strong relationships with 20+ enterprise customer stakeholders to maintain a reliable customer feedback loop

Requirements:
- 5+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years at a B2B SaaS company (required)
- Proven track record of shipping customer-facing features that moved business metrics (required)
- Strong written communication and PRD-writing skills (required)
- Experience managing cross-functional teams across engineering, design, and GTM functions (required)
- Proficiency with product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar) and SQL for ad-hoc analysis (required)

Nice to have:
- Experience in HR tech, workforce management, or enterprise productivity software
- Understanding of integration patterns (webhooks, REST APIs, iPaaS tools) from a product perspective
- MBA from a top-tier Indian institution (IIM, ISB) or equivalent international program
- Exposure to PLG (product-led growth) motions within a B2B SaaS context
- Experience working with customers in Southeast Asia or Middle East markets
